e.title: YOLO11m Car Damage Detector
e.summary: YOLO11m 车体损伤检测：凹陷/划痕/裂缝/碎灯/碎玻璃/瘪胎的定制训练检测器
e.body: YOLO11m Car Damage Detector 是基于 YOLO11m 的车体损伤检测器：在专门数据集上微调，检测与分类常见车体损伤——凹陷、划痕、裂缝、破损车灯、碎玻璃与瘪胎——面向真实世界检验流程。对 RIAA：车险理赔图像检测的现代实现（YOLO11）。与 [[autoscan-ai]]（车损分析流水线）、[[car-damage-assessment-ai]]（车损评估）、[[databricks-car-classification]]（车型分类）互补。关联 [[ins-mmbench]]（多模态基准）、[[claimpilot-harness]]。
e.verified_note: raw README 核实：YOLO11m 车体损伤检测（凹陷/划痕/裂缝/碎灯/碎玻璃/瘪胎），定制微调
e.summary_en: YOLO11m-based car body-damage detector: custom-trained to detect dents, scratches, cracks, broken lamps, shattered glass and flat tyres
e.summary_hk: YOLO11m 車體損傷檢測：凹陷/劃痕/裂縫/碎燈/碎玻璃/癟胎的定制訓練檢測器
e.body_en: YOLO11m Car Damage Detector is a YOLO11m-based car body-damage detector: fine-tuned on a specialised dataset to detect and classify common vehicle body damage — dents, scratches, cracks, broken lamps, shattered glass and flat tyres — built for real-world inspection workflows. For RIAA: a modern implementation of auto-claims image detection (YOLO11). Complements [[autoscan-ai]] (damage-analysis pipeline), [[car-damage-assessment-ai]] (damage assessment) and [[databricks-car-classification]] (vehicle classification). Related: [[ins-mmbench]] (multimodal benchmark), [[claimpilot-harness]].
e.body_hk: YOLO11m Car Damage Detector 是基於 YOLO11m 的車體損傷檢測器：在專門數據集上微調，檢測與分類常見車體損傷——凹陷、劃痕、裂縫、破損車燈、碎玻璃與癟胎——面向真實世界檢驗流程。對 RIAA：車險理賠圖像檢測的現代實現（YOLO11）。與 [[autoscan-ai]]（車損分析流水線）、[[car-damage-assessment-ai]]（車損評估）、[[databricks-car-classification]]（車型分類）互補。關聯 [[ins-mmbench]]（多模態基準）、[[claimpilot-harness]]。
